translations.literal: Once there was an edict assigning one censor as distant envoy; colleagues in turn declined and made excuses; Renben out of turn requested to go and spoke to Supervising Imperial Censor Ma Zhou, saying: "Eating the ruler's salary, dying for the ruler's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Once there was an edict assigning one censor as distant envoy; colleagues in turn declined and made excuses; Renben out of turn requested to go and spoke to Supervising Imperial Censor Ma Zhou, saying, "Eating the ruler's salary, dying for the ruler's affairs.

sentences.zh: 雖復跋涉艱險，所不敢辭也。”

translations.literal: Even if I must travel through hardship and danger, I dare not decline."
translations.idiomatic: Even if I must travel through hardship and danger, I dare not decline."

sentences.zh: 及回，事又稱旨，擢吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: When he returned the affair again accorded with intent and he was promoted to Outer Office Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned the affair again accorded with intent and he was promoted to Outer Office Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 乾封中，曆遷東臺侍郎、同東西臺三品，尋轉司列少常伯，知政事如故。

translations.literal: In the Qianfeng era he was repeatedly transferred to Vice Director of the Eastern Terrace and Grand Councilor of the Eastern and Western Terraces, and soon was transferred to Junior Grand Master of Personnel in the Ministry of Personnel, managing state affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianfeng era he was repeatedly transferred to Vice Director of the Eastern Terrace and Grand Councilor of the Eastern and Western Terraces, and soon was transferred to Junior Grand Master of Personnel in the Ministry of Personnel, managing state affairs as before.

sentences.zh: 時許敬宗為右相，頗任權勢，仁本拒其請托，遂為敬宗所構，俄授尚書左丞，罷知政事。

translations.literal: At that time Xu Jingzong was Right Chancellor and greatly wielded power; Renben refused his requests and entreaties and thereupon was framed by Jingzong; soon he was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and ceased managing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xu Jingzong was Right Chancellor and greatly wielded power; Renben refused his requests and entreaties and thereupon was framed by Jingzong; soon he was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and ceased managing state affairs.

sentences.zh: 咸亨初卒官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianheng he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianheng he died in office.

sentences.zh: 史臣論曰：崔、盧數公，皆以忠清文行，致位樞要。

translations.literal: The historian's comment says: The several gentlemen Cui and Lu all by loyal purity, literary conduct, and virtue reached pivotal posts.
translations.idiomatic: The historian's comment says: The several gentlemen Cui and Lu all by loyal purity, literary conduct, and virtue reached pivotal posts.

sentences.zh: 恪恭匪懈，以保名位，誠所謂持盈守成，太平之君子。

translations.literal: Reverently respectful without slackness, thereby preserving name and position—they are truly what is called holding fullness and guarding accomplishment, gentlemen of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently respectful without slackness, thereby preserving name and position—they are truly what is called holding fullness and guarding accomplishment, gentlemen of peace.

sentences.zh: 然敬玄之擢太玄，可謂能舉善者矣。

translations.literal: Yet Jingxuan's promotion of Taixuan can be called one who could raise the good.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Jingxuan's promotion of Taixuan can be called one who could raise the good.

sentences.zh: 義琰腐材而不營第舍，可謂有儉德矣。

translations.literal: Yiyan let timber rot and did not build a mansion—this can be called having frugal virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyan let timber rot and did not build a mansion—this can be called having frugal virtue.

sentences.zh: 彥瑋獨遏奸臣，仁本請當遠使，終升輔相，不亦宜乎！

translations.literal: Yanwei alone checked a treacherous minister; Renben requested to take the distant mission—they finally rose to auxiliary ministers: is this not fitting!
translations.idiomatic: Yanwei alone checked a treacherous minister; Renben requested to take the distant mission—they finally rose to auxiliary ministers: is this not fitting!

sentences.zh: 贊曰：盧、劉兩族，奕世名卿。

translations.literal: The encomium says: The two clans Lu and Liu, generation after generation famous ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: The two clans Lu and Liu, generation after generation famous ministers.

sentences.zh: 二李、二樂，俱號公清。

translations.literal: The two Li and two Le all were called public and pure.
translations.idiomatic: The two Li and two Le all were called public and pure.

sentences.zh: 權臣獨抗，美第不營。

translations.literal: Alone resisting powerful ministers, not building fine mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Alone resisting powerful ministers, not building fine mansions.

sentences.zh: 以茲輔弼，無愧德聲。

translations.literal: With these as auxiliary ministers, without shame to their reputation for virtue.
translations.idiomatic: With these as auxiliary ministers, without shame to their reputation for virtue.
